stage: Distinct second question; no new target outcome inspected by lead
question: Which externally defined FDA-approved solid-tumor antibody-drug-conjugate target antigens, if any, show appreciable and reproducibly elevated EMC RNA relative to relevant primary sarcoma comparisons?
rationale: Approved target/drug mechanisms supply a specific tissue-testing use; no inherited orphan-target ranking. Define full eligible target set from current official approval evidence before expression outcomes; reuse any matching prior evaluations.
prospective_scope: All eligible current FDA-approved solid-tumor ADC antigens as of2026-10-05, not arbitrarily added genes. Any actual target-list amendment must precede new values and retain original.
interpretation_limits: RNA not surface protein, antibody accessibility, sensitivity or efficacy.
Bulk compartment, normal tissue context, reference dependence, donor overlap and experimental gap must be tested/disclosed.
All relevant EMC observations/conditions must be evaluated before advancing.
Low signals/failed allocation are not automatically publication-worthy negative results.
Primary tissue/ADC prior art may defeat novelty; specific original assay and comparator needed.
method_stage: Source-gate target universe and EMC prior art; owner freezes coherent panel/comparators/thresholds/multiplicity and disproof before new values. Reuse shared existingRNA/arrays. Finite30min initialpilot, newrawsoft64MiB no duplicated fullinputs.
scientific_decision: Advance useful empirical contrast, one decisive follow-up then reassess, or shelve; do not keep adding targets until positive.
process: Start after old neurosecretory science freeze and first peerreview; preserve both original source freezes. Root integrates validated checkpoints while goal remains active.
